title: Closing thanks to the Smithsonian
summary: Crouch thanks Crawford, estimates five hours of material, and Crawford thanks the Smithsonian.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Okay, Mr. Crawford. Well, thank you very much for the interview. I think we've got five hours of material here, I'm not sure.

I hope so. If not, we can set it up again. But I don't want to overdo it, but I always give a little spare, and I hope we have enough. So thank you, and thank you, Smithsonian Institute, for including in your plans for a great, great tribute that is paid me. I really appreciate it. And thanks again for a great tribute.
